development_api_key.description: Maps Platform API key for debug builds; setup-secrets writes MAPS_API_KEY_DEBUG in local.properties; Gradle debug buildType uses it for google_maps_key. Enable Directions API on the same Cloud project/key for arrival/route info.

release_api_key.description: Maps Platform API key for release builds; setup-secrets writes MAPS_API_KEY_RELEASE; Gradle release buildType uses it for google_maps_key.

google_services.description: Must match the structure of Firebase android/google-services.json.

google_service_info_plist.description: Optional. Full XML contents of the Firebase iOS GoogleService-Info.plist; ios/scripts/setup-secrets.sh writes to ios/Outreach/Outreach/GoogleService-Info.plist. Prefer google_service_info_plist_base64 for a single-line value without escaping newlines in JSON.

google_service_info_plist_base64.description: Optional. Base64 of GoogleService-Info.plist (recommended for consolidated JSON: base64 -i GoogleService-Info.plist | tr -d '\n' ). ios/scripts/setup-secrets.sh decodes this to the gitignored plist path.

android_upload_signing.description: Upload keystore passwords for CI when using secrets/upload-keystore.jks.age (same passphrase as outreach-secrets.json.age). Omit for GitHub ANDROID_UPLOAD_* secrets-only signing.

key_alias.description: Key alias inside the PKCS12 upload keystore.

key_password.description: Private key password (often same as keystore password).
